lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Visible as a series of roughly vertical columns, each containing 4 to 6 high-luminance circular clusters, forming a repeating grid-like array along the mid-to-posterior lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: The high-luminance blobs are centered on vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with horizontal alignments to form a nodal grid pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A primary horizontal ridge is visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with a light upper edge and a shadowed lower edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Faint, low-contrast high-luminance clusters are sparsely and irregularly distributed within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin.

other_distinctive_markers: A complex vermiculated pattern of high-luminance lines is visible in the transitional zone between the head and the regular grid pattern of the mid-flank.
